why: A soft grey cat on a grey ground: the line made a maze, not a face.
Dark subject, light floor. But all black, so the face disappeared.
The face reads now. One long ruled jump still cut across it.
Every long jump untangled. 11,000 points, one line, 117,000 px long.
One wire in space, nearer where the photo is darker. Turn it and the picture opens into relief.
